title: Converting to No Charge removes prices and writes a note
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours priced at the customer's labor rate.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Convert to No Charge".
  4. Pick "Goodwill" in Category.
  5. Click the confirming Convert to No Charge button.
  6. Open the Notes tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Convert to No Charge".

Step 3:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 4:

  • Goodwill is picked.

Step 5:

  • The work order shows the "No Charge" badge and the orange header card.
  • The labor line shows 2.0 hours and no Rate or Total.

Step 6:

  • A read-only system note by ShopView, with the user and the time, reads "Converted to No Charge by [user]. Category Goodwill, original work order [number]. Prices, fees and discounts removed; costs and hours kept."

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly. With Goodwill no original work order is picked, so that part of the note names none.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R5: “On a billable work order on a regular customer, the three-dots menu offers "Convert to No Charge" (next to Add Work Order Fee / Discount) until the work order is invoiced. It opens the confirmation "Convert work order [number] to No Charge?" with the body "Prices, fees and discounts are removed from every line; costs and hours are kept. It closes with a NO CHARGE document instead of an invoice. You can convert it back until it is closed.", the required select "Category" (active No Charge categories; empty by default, "Pick a category" when missing), the selects "Original work order" and "Original line" of S2-R2 when the category requires it, and the buttons Cancel and "Convert to No Charge". Confirming applies S2-R3 and S2-R4, stores the category, the original work order and line, and writes the note of S2-R18. There is no checkbox on the work order detail. If the work order already carries no-charge lines (Story 12), converting it makes every line No Charge under the chosen category; the lines' own categories are replaced and the note names them.”
  • S2-R18: “Every classification change writes a read-only system note on the work order (Notes tab, author ShopView, with the user and the time) and an Audit Log row: Convert to No Charge ("Converted to No Charge by [user]. Category [name], original work order [number]. Prices, fees and discounts removed; costs and hours kept."), Change category (from, to, original work order kept or cleared), Convert to Billable ("Every line priced as a new line would be today. Category [name] removed."), Close (posting date, account), Reopen, and the line actions of Story 12 (S12-R6). Work order numbers in notes are links.”
  • S2-R13: “The classification is written on the work order when it is created, when its customer changes and when it is converted; the closed record carries it too, with the category. Lists, reports and integrations read it from there, never from the customer flag. Converting to no charge or to billable, changing the category, a shop supplies amount change, Make internal (S1-R11, on each work order), Close with its posting date, Reopen, and adding or removing a customer's Internal flag are recorded in the work order or customer Audit Log with the user and the time.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions (Action | Needs | Without it): “No Charge at creation, Convert to No Charge, Convert to Billable, Change category | 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' and 'See Financial Data' | Checkbox and actions hidden, as Add Work Order Fee / Discount (S2-N2)”
